emptyFinishedTitle: Finished recordings will show up here
emptyDescription: Record from a live room; its task appears here.
saveDirResetDesc: Back to the default under the download folder; recordings already saved stay where they are.
folderInUseBody: {count} take(s) will keep writing to the old folder and their files stay there; only new recordings use the new folder, and existing files are not moved.
folderChangedActive: New folder saved; the running takes are still in the old folder
saveDirDefaultInUse: The default folder is already in use.
resetAllConfirmDesc: Quality, naming, segments, limits, live check and cache return to their defaults; the save folder and danmaku formats are left as they are.
namingDescription: Date, time, platform, room id and title placeholders are available.
namingDialogHint: Enter the naming template for recording files
namingFieldsCaption: Fields you can use (tap to insert):
maxSizeLimitDesc: When off, a take is not ended by size; segments are still cut by duration.
maxSizeDescription: Ends the take once it reaches the cap; measured in MB.
warningJoinFailed: Join failed; the segments are kept in the folder
warningTranscodeFailed: Transcode failed; the untranscoded MP4 is kept
warningFinalizeFailed: Post-processing failed; the recording files are kept
warningStaleProcessing: The last join/transcode did not finish; check the task folder
warningDiskLow: Free space ran low and the recording stopped; the segments are kept
warningCanceled: Post-processing was cancelled; the recording files are kept
retryJoinBusy: That take is recording or processing already
retryJoinGone: This recording's folder cannot be found
retryJoinNothing: No joinable segments left in that folder — it may already be merged
stopAllBody: {count: int} room(s) now recording end and save; segments already written stay and post-processing runs as usual.
clearSettledBody: {count: int} task rows leave the list; the recordings stay in their folders. Rooms recording, still processing or waiting to go live are untouched.
mergeTitle: Merge the other folder's recordings here?
mergeBody: {count: int} recording(s) live in another folder. On one disk the folder is only renamed; across disks every file is copied and measured against the source, and the source folder is deleted only when the copy matches. Task rows follow the new path; rooms recording or still processing are untouched.
mergeDesc: {count: int} finished recording(s) live in another folder and can be merged here
mergePartial: Merged {moved: int}; {failed: int} did not finish
caCustomDesc: Not set: recordings trust the bundled Mozilla store. Picking your own bundle (PEM text) trusts a corporate root or a self-signed chain without switching verification off.
caCustomMissing: {name} is no longer where the row found it — recordings will fail; pick it again or clear it
caCustomNotPem: That is not a PEM certificate bundle (it should contain -----BEGIN CERTIFICATE-----)
caCustomPickFailed: The certificate file could not be read
caCustomCleared: Recording uses the bundled root store again
startNowBusyOther: Another window is recording this room
startNowCaFailed: The custom CA bundle cannot be read — pick it again or switch to the bundled store
deleteBody: This removes the task only; files already saved stay on disk.
segmentDescription: How long each segment runs; finished segments stay playable after a crash.
readTimeoutDescription: How long a silent live input is waited for before the read fails.
queueDescription: The FFmpeg input packet queue; a larger one absorbs live bursts.
preferBestDescription: Map only the first video and audio streams, so a multi-bitrate source does not become a multi-track file.
keepAliveDescription: Hold a background session and wake lock while recording (Android foreground service and notification).
verifyDescription: Check the segments are playable before the session ends.
tlsVerifyDesc: Off accepts self-signed or proxy-intercepted certificates; the server's identity is then unverified and interception is possible.
restartDescription: How often FFmpeg reopens a broken stream; 0 disables retries.
backoffDescription: The wait between two reopen attempts.
stallDescription: How long without new data counts as a stalled stream and reopens it.
diskWatermarkLimitDesc: When off, a capture does not stop for low free space.
watermarkDescription: Stop recording when free space falls below this.
maxTasksLimitDesc: When off, no concurrency cap applies; waiting takes start in queue order.
maxTasksDescription: New recording requests are refused once this many run.
containerDescription: TS survives interruptions best; MP4 opens in ordinary players.
combineDesc: After the take ends, its segments are copied into one MP4 without re-encoding; a failed join keeps the segments.
combineDeleteOriginalsDesc: Keep only the MP4; off moves the segments into an original folder beside it so the join can be retried.
transcodeDesc: Re-encodes the joined MP4 to H.264; it takes longer with the recording's length and lowers the source quality.
transcodeBitrateDesc: Target video bitrate; higher is clearer and larger.
previewUnavailable: This task holds no file a player can open
recordChatGiftsDesc: Writes gift messages, in the text the platform gives, into the same danmaku file; the chat alone is the default.
recordChatDescription: Save live chat beside each video in the formats chosen under Danmaku → Danmaku save formats; needs a platform with remote chat
defaultQualityDesc: Ask the platform for this quality when a recording starts; when it is unavailable, the current playback line is used.
enablePollingDesc: Automatically poll while the streamer is offline; add a room with “Record when live” in the room’s more menu. Off, waiting rooms and scheduled windows never begin a take on their own — “Start now” still works.
pollingOff: Live check is off; waiting and scheduled tasks will not start automatically.
cacheLimitEnabledDesc: Delete the oldest finished takes when the cap is exceeded; active recordings are never deleted.
cacheLimitDesc: Measured in MB; above it the oldest takes are deleted, never an active recording.
cacheSizeDesc: Total bytes of finished and active files in the managed folder.
cacheClearDesc: Delete every finished take and its danmaku XML; active recordings stay.
cacheClearConfirmDesc: This deletes finished videos, segments and danmaku files in the managed folder and cannot be undone; active recordings are skipped.
liveCheckSecondsDesc: How often each waiting task checks its room, 10–300 seconds.
checkBackoffDesc: Stretch the interval after repeated failures so the platform is not polled too often.
maxCheckSecondsDesc: The ceiling the stretched interval approaches, 60–3600 seconds.
autoStartOnBootDesc: Turn tasks still marked recording after an interrupted process into waiting tasks for the live check — with the live check off, one check runs at launch; stopped and finished tasks keep their state. Off, an interrupted row stays “recording” and has to be deleted and added again.
stateRecordingElsewhere: This window is not writing it: if another window is recording, that one owns it; otherwise the last process was interrupted — delete the task and add it again.
scheduleEnableDesc: Outside the window the platform is not asked; inside it the normal live check applies. After a take stops, the next window arms it again.
scheduleOvernightHint: An end earlier than the start crosses midnight; equal start and end means the whole day.
scheduleStopAtEnd: Stop recording at the window's end
scheduleStopAtEndDesc: Off keeps a take running past the window until the stream ends.
cacheBusy: A recording is in progress (possibly in another window); the cache will not be cleared or trimmed now.
cacheOtherRoot: A take is still writing to the old folder; this page's size, clear and automatic trimming cover the current folder only.
